description: Marks plan materials as bought (or un-marks them) when the user says in the chat that they bought something. The plan widget has the same 🛒 tick per material. Bought lines stay in the estimate; the plan shows «bought» and «left to buy». Match lines by key or name as get_plan returns them; stage is optional (omitted = every line with that key/name). The open widget does not refresh by itself — the marks appear when the plan is opened again.
name: mark_bought
title: Mark materials bought
